title: Light Crispy Egyptian Lentil Fried Rice
description: A salty and crispy Egyptian dish featuring mint, perfect for a brunch mood, made with a whisk and macrobiotic-friendly ingredients, cooked in a wok.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large wok over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the cooked lentils, cooked rice, chopped mint leaves, salt, and black pepper to the wok.
Stir-fry the mixture for 5 minutes, breaking up any clumps with a whisk or spatula.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Continue to cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring frequently, until the mixture is crispy and lightly browned.
Remove the wok from the heat and serve the Light Crispy Egyptian Lentil Fried Rice hot.
